Package controller

Interface Features

  • All Known Implementing Classes:
    GraphicalController
    public interface Features
    The Features interface defines all the user-interaction callbacks that the controller will handle, typically triggered by the View (GUI).

    • Method Detail

      • createCalendar

        void createCalendar​(java.lang.String name,
                    java.lang.String timezone)
        Creates a new calendar with the given name and timezone. This method is triggered when user enters the name and timezone of calendar.
        Parameters:
        name - the name of the calendar
        timezone - the timezone for the calendar

      • viewEvents

        java.util.List<java.lang.String> viewEvents​(java.time.LocalDate date)
        Retrieves a list of event summaries scheduled on a specific date. This method is triggered when user clicks on a day in the month view of the calendar.
        Parameters:
        date - the date to view events for
        Returns:
        list of event summaries

      • editEvent

        void editEvent​(java.lang.String subject,
               java.time.LocalDate startDate,
               java.time.LocalTime startTime,
               java.time.LocalDate endDate,
               java.time.LocalTime endTime,
               java.lang.String property,
               java.lang.String newValue)
        Edits a specific property of an existing event. This method is triggered when user clicks on an event in the month view of the calendar. User cannot edit an event when the subject, startDate and startTime conflict with each other.
        Parameters:
        subject - the subject/title of the event
        startDate - start date of the event
        startTime - start time of the event
        endDate - end date of the event
        endTime - end time of the event
        property - the property to be edited (e.g., "location", "description","subject", "startDate","startTime","endDate","endTime")
        newValue - the new value for the specified property

      • editEvents

        void editEvents​(java.lang.String subject,
                boolean allEvents,
                java.time.LocalDate startDate,
                java.time.LocalTime startTime,
                java.lang.String property,
                java.lang.String newValue)
        Edits a specific property of multiple existing events. Either all the events matching the provided event name/subject or events after a specified point of time are edited.
        Parameters:
        subject - the subject/title of the multiple event
        allEvents - specifies if all events are to be edited or not
        startDate - specified date after which events are to be edited
        startTime - specified time on above date after which events are to be edited
        property - the event property to be edited
        newValue - the new value to be put for the specified event property

      • createEvent

        void createEvent​(java.lang.String subject,
                 java.time.LocalDate startDate,
                 java.time.LocalTime startTime,
                 java.time.LocalDate endDate,
                 java.time.LocalTime endTime,
                 java.lang.String description,
                 java.lang.String location,
                 java.lang.Boolean isPrivate,
                 boolean isRecurring,
                 java.lang.String daysOfWeek,
                 boolean isOccurrences,
                 int occurrences,
                 java.time.LocalDate specificEndDate)
        Creates a new event with specified parameters, including recurrence. This method is triggered when user clicks "Add New Event" button in the view event pane of the GUI.
        Parameters:
        subject - the title of the event
        startDate - the start date
        startTime - the start time
        endDate - the end date
        endTime - the end time
        description - description of the event
        location - event location
        isPrivate - whether the event is private
        isRecurring - whether the event is recurring
        daysOfWeek - days the event recurs on (if applicable)
        isOccurrences - whether recurrence is based on number of occurrences
        occurrences - number of occurrences (if applicable)
        specificEndDate - the specific end date for recurrence (if applicable)

      • useCalendar

        void useCalendar​(java.lang.String calendar)
        Switches to a specified calendar by name. This method is triggered when user selects a particular calendar from the dropdown menu of GUI. User need not create a calendar to create an event. The "Default" Calendar is already selected for the user by the application.
        Parameters:
        calendar - the name of the calendar to use

      • importCalendar

        void importCalendar​(java.lang.String fileName)
             throws java.lang.IllegalArgumentException
        Imports a calendar from the specified file. This method accepts file in the csv format which adheres to Google Calendar norms. This method is triggered when user enters the name of the file to be imported.
        Parameters:
        fileName - the file name that we want to import.
        Throws:
        java.lang.IllegalArgumentException - if provided name does not end with ".csv" extension.

      • exportCalendar

        void exportCalendar​(java.lang.String fileName)
        Exports events in the csv file format which adheres to Google Calendar norms. This method is triggered when user enters the name of the file to be imported.
        Parameters:
        fileName - the name or path of the file to import from
        Throws:
        java.lang.IllegalArgumentException - if provided name does not end with ".csv" extension.
